name: app-bmw-i7-automotive-dashboard-on-tablet-stand
title: BMW i7 automotive dashboard on a tablet stand: dark UI with orange energy charts and seat heating
whatItIs: A tablet on a desk stand showing a dark car app: 'Good evening' header with the car photo, battery and charging gauges, orange bar charts of energy consumption, tyre pressure, a performance line chart and a climate view with blue-lit seats, with a finger tapping the screen.
whatItMeans: Premium and technical; amber accents on black echo a car's night-time instrument panel.
techniques: Borrow the palette of real car interiors.
Lead with a photo of the owner's vehicle.
Use small multiples of charts in a card grid.

vocabulary.definition: Many small charts in a grid for comparison.
An app that controls or monitors a device.
